name: React PDF Flipbook Viewer
summary: React and Next.js PDF viewer that renders a document as an interactive flipbook with zoom, pan, fullscreen and a page slider.
description: A Next.js viewer that displays a PDF from a URL as a page-flipping flipbook. It provides zoom and pan, fullscreen mode, keyboard arrow navigation, a page slider, share buttons and a responsive layout, with four documented components: FlipbookViewer, Toolbar, Flipbook and SliderNav. Built with react-pdf, react-pageflip and react-zoom-pan-pinch; MIT licensed.
contains: renders a PDF from a URL as a page-flip flipbook
zoom and pan, fullscreen mode and keyboard arrow navigation
components: FlipbookViewer, Toolbar, Flipbook and SliderNav
built on react-pdf, react-pageflip and react-zoom-pan-pinch
